guide.intro: Indlela i-LawBid esebenza ngayo: ubani obona ini, idatha yakho ivikelwa kanjani nokuthi yimiphi imithetho esebenzayo. Thepha isigaba ukuze usivule.
guide.s1.body:
I-LawBid yibhodi yezikhangiso: amakhasimende athumela amacala, bese abameli abaqinisekisiwe bethumela iziphakamiso kuwo.

I-LawBid akuyona inkampani yabameli, ayinikezi izeluleko zezomthetho futhi ayinasibopho ngomsebenzi wommeli noma umphumela wecala.

Uvumelana ngokukhokha nommeli futhi umkhokhela ngqo.
guide.s1.title: Indlela esisebenza ngayo
guide.s2.title: Ubani obona icala lakho
guide.s3.body:
Ngaphambi kokuthi isiphakamiso samukelwe, ummeli angakubhalela engxoxweni yecala. Lapho uvela njengeklayenti lecala, ngaphandle kwegama lakho. Izinombolo zocingo nama-email emilayezweni kufihlwa ngokuzenzakalela, futhi izithombe namadokhumenti angeke athunyelwe.

Uma usamukele isiphakamiso, ingxoxo nalowo mmeli ivuleka ngokugcwele: amafayela angathunyelwa futhi imininingwane yokuxhumana ayisafihlwa. Ummeli ubona imininingwane yokuxhumana esephrofayeleni yakho ecaleni uma enokubhalisa okusebenzayo noma isikhathi sokuzama. Ngaphambi kwecala lakho lokuqala uyavuma ukuthi imininingwane yakho yokuxhumana iya kummeli owamukela isiphakamiso sakhe. Izingxoxo zabanye abameli ngaleli cala ziba ngezokufunda kuphela.

Uma uvala icala, iziphakamiso ezisebenzayo zenqatshwa futhi izingxoxo zalo ziba ngezokufunda kuphela.
guide.s3.title: Imininingwane yokuxhumana nengxoxo
guide.s4.body:
Ummeli angengeza abasizi. Umsizi omusha akanawo nhlobo amalungelo. Ummeli uvula isibopho ngasinye ngokwehlukana futhi wamukela umthwalo ophelele ngezenzo zomsizi, kuhlanganise nangaphansi kwemithetho yesifundazwe sakhe yokwengamela abasebenzi abangebona abameli. Isibopho singavalwa noma nini.

Izibopho: izingcingo, izingxoxo, amafayela ezingxoxweni, amacala, okusalungiswa kweziphakamiso, okuthunyelwe, imisebenzi, iphrofayela, ukuthumela iziphakamiso nokushicilela ngaphandle kokugunyazwa.

Umsizi onokufinyelela emacaleni ubona imininingwane yamacala ommeli, kuhlanganise nemininingwane eyimfihlo yamacala lapho isiphakamiso sommeli samukelwa khona. Umsizi onokufinyelela ezingxoxweni ubona zonke izingxoxo zommeli, futhi imilayezo yakhe imakwa njengeyomsizi.
guide.s4.title: Abasizi babameli
guide.s5.body:
Izithombe namadokhumenti amacala nezingxoxo kugcinwa endaweni yokugcina eyimfihlo. Kuvuleka kuphela ngesixhumanisi esivikelekile esisebenza ihora elilodwa. Amadokhumenti okuqinisekisa ommeli avuleka ngesixhumanisi semizuzu emi-5 futhi kubabuyekezi kuphela. Ifayela ngalinye lihlolwa yi-antivirus, futhi kuboniswa amafayela ahlanzekile kuphela.

Imibhalo yemilayezo igcinwa ibethelwe kuseva (AES-256).

Umlayezo othunyelwe awukwazi ukususwa noma ukuhlelwa.

Abasebenzi be-LawBid babona idatha kuphela ngenxa yokusekela, ukubuyekeza imibiko nalapho umthetho udinga khona.
guide.s5.title: Amafayela nemilayezo
guide.s6.body:
Isiphakamiso yisicelo sommeli ngecala lakho: intengo, imigomo nokuthi angaqala nini. Abameli abaqinisekisiwe abanokubhalisa okusebenzayo noma isikhathi sokuzama kuphela abangathumela iziphakamiso. Uma ukubhalisa kuphela, iziphakamiso zabo ezilindile ziyahoxiswa. Uma icala lingaphandle kwemikhakha yokusebenza yommeli, isiphakamiso siyamakwa futhi uyakubona lokho.

Izigaba zecala: Kushicilelwe, Iziphakamiso, Iyaqhubeka, Ukuphothula, Kuqediwe. Uma uhlangothi olulodwa luthepha “Kwenziwe”, olunye luyaqinisekisa noma luvule ingxabano, futhi umlamuli we-LawBid uphatha leyo ngxabano. Uma kungekho mpendulo, icala livaleka ngokwalo ngemva kwezinsuku ezi-7.

Wena nommeli nivumelana ngokwenu ngenkokhelo, inani layo, indlela nesikhathi sayo, futhi umkhokha ngqo. I-LawBid ayibambi iqhaza kulezi zinkokhelo futhi ayinamthwalo ngazo.

Uma ungasalidingi icala, livale. Uma kunesikhathi ungalivulanga icala elivulekile, siyabuza ukuthi lisadingeka yini: ku-“Kuphuthuma kakhulu” ngemva kwezinsuku ezi-2, “Kuphuthuma” ngemva kwezi-4, “Kuleli sonto” ngemva kwezi-7, “Phakathi nenyanga” kanye no-“Akukho ukushesha” ngemva kwezi-30. Umbuzo ufika phakathi kuka-9:00 no-21:00 ngesikhathi sakho. Uma kungekho mpendulo, icala limiswa ngemva kosuku olu-1, ezi-2, ezi-3, ezi-4 nezi-14 ngokulandelana, kanti icala elinosuku limiswa ezinsukwini ezi-3 ngemva kwalolo suku. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezi-30 limisiwe, icala liya kungobo yomlando. Ungalibuyisela ku-feed ngokuthepha okukodwa. Kubalwa izenzo zakho kuphela. Lezi yizikhathi ezizenzakalelayo.
guide.s6.title: Iziphakamiso, izigaba zecala nokukhokha
guide.s7.body:
Ngemva kokuvalwa kwecala, iklayenti lingabuyekeza ummeli elamukela isiphakamiso sakhe, futhi ummeli angabuyekeza iklayenti. Isibuyekezo singahlelwa phakathi nesikhathi sokuhlela futhi asikwazi ukususwa ku-app.

Ungabika okuthunyelwe, amazwana, umlayezo, icala, isibuyekezo, umsebenzisi noma iphakethe lezitikha. Okuqukethwe okubikwe ngabantu abahlukene aba-3 kufihlwa kuze kube umlamuli uyanquma. Imibiko ngamaphrofayela namacala ibuyekezwa ngumlamuli. Umlamuli angasusa okuqukethwe, noma akhawulele i-akhawunti noma ayivimbe.

Ukuvimba kusebenza ngakubili: aniboni futhi aningathumelelani imilayezo. Ukuvimba akuyivali ingxoxo yecala eselivele liqhubeka.

Izinombolo zocingo, ama-email nezixhumanisi azivunyelwe esihlokweni noma esifinyezweni secala, edolobheni, kumazwana ecala noma ezibuyekezweni: umbhalo onjalo awugcinwa.
guide.s7.title: Izibuyekezo, imibiko nemithetho
guide.s8.body:
Ungasusa i-akhawunti yakho kumaSethingi. Ngemva kwesicelo, uphuma kuzo zonke izisetshenziswa, futhi ngemva kwezinsuku ezi-14 i-akhawunti yenziwa ingaziwa. Uma ungena phakathi nalezo zinsuku ezi-14, ukususwa kuyakhanselwa.

Ukwenza ingaziwa kushintsha igama lakho, kushintsha umbhalo wemilayezo yakho ube “[deleted]”, futhi kususa isithombe sakho sephrofayela, amadokhumenti okuqinisekisa, amafayela namanothi ezwi owawathumela, okuthunyelwe nokulandela. Amacala avulekile aya kungobo yomlando, amacala aqhubekayo ayavalwa futhi uhlangothi olunye luyaziswa. Ukubhalisa kommeli kuyakhanselwa.

Irekhodi lecala, amarekhodi okudalulwa kwemininingwane yokuxhumana, izimvume namarekhodi okungena kugcinwa iminyaka emi-5 ngaphandle kwedatha yakho yomuntu siqu.

Ngaphambi kokususa ungalanda idatha yakho kumaSethingi.
